<!-- Read Data Output (Left) --> <mxCell id="wire_ext_rdata" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=3;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="80" y="295" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="10" y="295" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_ext_rdata" value="<b>rdata[31:0]</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="273" width="75" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- SUBMODULE 1: pwm_registers --> <mxCell id="mod_regs" value="<b><font style="font-size: 15px;">pwm_registers</font></b><br><i>Bus Decoder &amp; Register Bank</i>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2.5;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="110" width="250" height="230" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="reg_ch0_7" value="<b>DUTY_CH0..7 Registers</b><br>Addr: 0x0 – 0x7 [7:0] Duty Values" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="95" y="160" width="220" height="35" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="reg_enable" value="<b>ENABLE_REG Register</b><br>Addr: 0x8 | Bit 0: Global | Bits 8:1: Ch 7:0" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="95" y="205" width="220" height="35" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="reg_mux" value="<b>Address Decoder &amp; Read MUX</b><br>Synchronous single-cycle readback" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="95" y="250" width="220" height="35" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="reg_clk_rst" value="<i>Clocked by clk, resets on arst_n</i>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=10;fontColor=#555555;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="95" y="300" width="220" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- SUBMODULE 2: pwm_counter --> <mxCell id="mod_counter" value="<b><font style="font-size: 15px;">pwm_counter</font></b><br><i>Shared Timing Reference Generator</i>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2.5;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="380" width="250" height="205" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="cnt_core" value="<b>8-Bit Up-Counter (0..255)</b><br>Synchronous to clk | Clears when arst_n=0" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="95" y="435" width="220" height="38" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="cnt_tick" value="<b>Period Tick Generator</b><br>1-cycle strobe @ rollover (count == 8'd255)" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="95" y="485" width="220" height="38" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="cnt_notes" value="<i>Counter increments when global_en == 1</i>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=10;fontColor=#555555;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="95" y="540" width="220" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Global Enable wire from Registers to Counter --> <mxCell id="wire_reg_to_cnt" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="205" y="340" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="205" y="380" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_reg_to_cnt" value="<b>global_en</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="215" y="352" width="60" height="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- SUBMODULE 3: pwm_channel [7:0] --> <mxCell id="mod_channels" value="<b><font style="font-size: 16px;">pwm_channel [7:0] Instances</font></b><br><i>8 Parallel Glitch-Free Channel Engines</i>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2.5;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="470" y="110" width="480" height="475" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Channel Slice [i] Architecture --> <mxCell id="slice_box" value="<b>Individual Channel Slice [i] Internal Architecture</b>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;dashed=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="490" y="160" width="440" height="215" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Shadow Register --> <mxCell id="box_shadow" value="<b>Shadow Register</b><br><font style="font-size: 10px;">duty_shadow[7:0]<br>Latches on period_tick</font>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="510" y="200" width="135" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Magnitude Comparator --> <mxCell id="box_cmp" value="<b>Magnitude CMP</b><br><font style="font-size: 10px;">8-bit unsigned compare<br>counter &lt; duty_shadow</font>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="750" y="200" width="145" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Wire from shadow to comparator (with generous 105px gap) --> <mxCell id="wire_shadow_cmp" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="645" y="240" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="750" y="240" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_shadow_val" value="duty_shadow[7:0]" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="645" y="218" width="105" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Output Gating Logic --> <mxCell id="box_gate" value="<b>Output Gating AND Gate</b><br>global_en &amp;&amp; ch_en[i] &amp;&amp; cmp_out" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="620" y="305" width="275" height="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Wire from CMP to Gate --> <mxCell id="wire_cmp_to_gate" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="820" y="275" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="820" y="305" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_raw_pwm" value="cmp_out" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=9;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="826" y="282" width="50" height="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Multi-Channel Replication Details --> <mxCell id="box_channel_array" value="<b>Replicated Channels (CH0 .. CH7):</b><br>• Each channel maintains an isolated shadow register.<br>• Individual channel enables (ch_en[0] .. ch_en[7]) qualify PWM outputs independently.<br>• Synchronous duty-cycle updates prevent truncated or runt pulses across all 8 channels." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="490" y="395" width="440" height="165" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- INTER-MODULE WIRES (Clean Non-Overlapping Lanes) --> <!-- Duty Cycle bus --> <mxCell id="wire_duty_bus" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="330" y="175" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="510" y="220" as="targetPoint" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="430" y="175" /> <mxPoint x="430" y="220" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_duty_bus" value="<b>duty_reg[0..7]</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="340" y="153" width="85" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Enables bus --> <mxCell id="wire_en_bus" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="330" y="235" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="620" y="330" as="targetPoint" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="410" y="235" /> <mxPoint x="410" y="330" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_en_bus" value="<b>global_en, ch_en[7:0]</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="335" y="213" width="120" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Counter value to Comparator --> <mxCell id="wire_cnt_val" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="330" y="445" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="750" y="260" as="targetPoint" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="390" y="445" /> <mxPoint x="390" y="260" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_cnt_val" value="<b>counter[7:0]</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="340" y="423" width="85" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Period Tick to Shadow Register --> <mxCell id="wire_period_tick" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="330" y="505" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="510" y="260" as="targetPoint" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="450" y="505" /> <mxPoint x="450" y="260" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_period_tick" value="<b>period_tick</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=10;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="340" y="483" width="85" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- PWM OUTPUTS (RIGHT) --> <mxCell id="wire_pwm_outs" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=3;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="895" y="332" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1010" y="332" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_pwm_outs" value="<b>pwm_out[7:0]</b><br><font style="color:#444;">8-Channel PWM Outputs</font>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=11;fontColor=#000000;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="900" y="295" width="120" height="32" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
svg.text: Clocked by clk, resets on arst_n
• Each channel has an independent shadow register latch.
• Latches new duty cycle on period boundary (glitch immunity).
• Global enable hierarchy gates all channels concurrently.
